items.title: 8. Time of Collisions is Negligible (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 8. Time of Collisions is Negligible: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Do particles ki takkar bohat hi thore waqt mein ho jati hai, do takkaron ke darmiyan ke waqt ke muqable mein. Is assumption se particles ki motion ka hisab aasaan ho jata hai.
